meta.title: cod by nasser | AI, software and branding for your business
meta.description: AI and data analysis, websites, online stores and custom systems, and a brand that wins clients. I build what works for your business, and stay after launch.

hero.titleHtml: I turn your data and ideas into systems that work for you.
hero.lede: For business owners and companies: AI that understands your data, software made to fit your work, and a brand that reaches your audience. I build it myself, and stay with you after launch.
hero.photoAlt: Nasser with his eyes closed, his ghost behind him

problems.title: Does this happen in your business?
problems.intro: If you find your problem here, it has a solution. Click it and I’ll show you how.
problems.other: Didn’t find your problem? Tell me about it

items.cost: So you decide by instinct, without knowing where you gain and where you lose.
So your day goes on replying and copying, and the customer who got no answer leaves.
So the idea stays on hold, or you spend on it before you ask.
So a customer looks for you, and finds someone else.
So your account goes quiet for weeks, and your followers forget you.
So you work hard at posting, and sales stay where they are.

doors.title: Three divisions for your business.
doors.intro: Each division is a set of services that complete each other. Start with the one closest to your need.

industries.title: Solutions made for your field.
industries.intro: The same services, as they look in your field’s work.

items.name: Clinics and doctors
items.text: An assistant that answers patients’ questions and arranges appointments, and a website that introduces the doctor and their experience.

items.name: Lawyers and consultants
items.text: A professional website that builds trust, and an internal assistant that answers from the office’s files and templates.

items.name: Shops and stores
items.text: An online shop that runs orders and stock, content that sells, and a forecast of demand before the goods run out.

items.name: Education and training
items.text: Platforms and management systems, an assistant that answers students, and content that reaches learners.

items.name: Companies and organisations
items.text: Performance dashboards, models on the company’s data, and internal systems that automate the workflow.

items.name: Startups
items.text: Studying the idea, a first product that tests the market, and a brand to launch with.

work.title: Work that runs now.
work.intro: Two of my projects: one with Sberbank, the other I run myself for real users.

why.title: So why work with me?
why.intro: Because what I offer you, I build with my own hands.
why.deskAlt: Nasser at his desk, writing in a notebook with a pen, his computer in front of him

points.title: I build it myself
points.text: I train the model on your business’s own data, so it fits your work, unlike a generic tool you pay for every month. That’s how my project with Sberbank did away with a paid subscription.

points.title: I run what I build
points.text: What I launch, I run myself, like the TutuBot platform on Telegram, with people who actually use it, so I know what happens after launch, not only before it.

points.title: I explain what I deliver
points.text: You don’t just receive a tool. You understand it. And as your business grows, I develop it with you.
